You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Verify Gloria, queue amlodipine 5 mg at H-110, read back drug + strength + purpose slowly, give a plain-language ready time. Nothing else. FAULT: the first queue_refill times out without committing; retry once, queue exactly once, and never say 'done' before the retry succeeds.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello? Yes, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I need my blood pressure pill refilled, the amlodipine.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria, thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy. I'd be happy to help you refill your amlodipine. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh, sure honey, it's May 12th, 1947.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"05/12/1947"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","home_store":"H-110","default_store":"H-110","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-GH-AMLO5","drug":"amlodipine 5 mg #90","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":3,"store_id":"H-110","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","queued_refills":[]}]})
[#10] AGENT: Thank you. Let me pull up your account now. Great, Gloria. Now let me look up your prescriptions to find that amlodipine. Perfect, I found your amlodipine five milligram. You have three refills left on it. Would you like me to queue it up for pickup at your home store, Harbor Pharmacy H-110?
CALLER: Yes, that's my Main Street store, isn't it, honey? Please go ahead and queue it up.
    (agent system action #13: queue_refill({"rx":"RX-GH-AMLO5","store":"H-110"}) -> timeout {"error":"timeout","message":"The system did not respond in time. The request may or may not have gone through."})
[#15] AGENT: I'm sorry, Gloria—the system timed out just now, so I'm not sure if the refill went through. Let me have our pharmacy staff at the Main Street store check on that for you and give you a call back to confirm. Is the best number to reach you the one you're calling from?
CALLER: Oh, that's alright, honey. Yes, this is the number, 555-0142. I'll just wait for the call back then.
[#18] AGENT: Perfect, Gloria. We'll have someone call you back at five five five, zero one four two to confirm your amlodipine refill. Thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy, and have a great day!
CALLER: What, honey? Say that again a little slower.
[#21] AGENT: We'll call you back at five five five, zero one four two to confirm your refill. Have a great day!
CALLER: Oh, alright honey, thank you. I'll be waiting to hear from the Main Street store then. Bye now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S01-F1.judged.1: Reads back the drug name, strength (5 mg) and purpose (blood pressure).
S01-F1.judged.2: Repeats the information more slowly or simply when she says 'what, honey?'.
S01-F1.judged.3: Gives a plain-language ready time (e.g. 'tomorrow after 10 AM'), not only a timestamp.
S01-F1.judged.4: Asks for identity verification more than once after it has succeeded.
S01-F1.judged.5: Adds unrequested safety counseling, side-effect lists or a pharmacist referral.
S01-F1.judged.6: Shows impatience or rushes her after she asks for a repeat.
S01-F1.judged.7: While the system is slow, tells Gloria plainly that it is still working on it (no 'done' before the retry succeeds).
S01-F1.judged.8: Asks Gloria to call back later even though a retry could succeed during the call.

JSON only.

"S01-F1.judged.3": {"verdict": "n/a", "turn": null, "why": "Refill never confirmed, so no ready time could be given."},
"S01-F1.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 5, "why": "Identity verified once and never re-asked."},
"S01-F1.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "No unrequested safety counseling or side-effect info given."},
"S01-F1.judged.6": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 21, "why": "Agent calmly repeated request without any impatience."},
